Tools › Free [...] Quick start  
 1. Hit New All until a base gradient grabs you.  
 2. Adjust the sub-layers, stops and angle, or switch on Fractal, Flow Warp, Displacement and Symmetry.  
 3. When the live preview looks good, Bake Layer. Keep generating and baking, or rework baked layers in the Layers panel.  
 4. Set Noise, Brightness and Saturation, then save the PNG or grab the CSS.

What it's good for

Poster backdrops, website headers, album art, screen-print bases, VJ loops, and base images for Bucket Bender, where you can sort, glitch and transform them into something new.

What's included  
 StrataFlux.html is the complete single-file app. Open it locally in any modern browser or host it on your own web space. Updates are free, and new effects engines will show up as I build them.

Client Services Manager [...] I'm posting this under my real name. I know that puts some of my privacy at risk. Customer service has never passed my case up, so I'm writing this to get past them and in front of STRATA's management team. I'd also rather other families hear this now than find out the way I did. [...] I asked customer service more than once to escalate my case to management. It never happened. I've never spoken to anyone outside the customer service team. Every call and email sends me back to the same people, who can't make a decision and won't pass it to anyone who can.  
  
A Durable POA exists for moments when a family needs to act quickly. Seven years without a decision is not caution. It's a process that doesn't work, and the families who need it most have the least time to wait.  
  
If you or someone you care for might ever need an agent to step in on a STRATA account, ask them up front how long POA review takes and get the answer in writing. I wish I had.
